records.name: Standard Fabric Terms
records.terms_text:
1. Delivery: delay of 1-3 days 0%, 4-11 days 10%, 12-21 days 25%, over 21 days order cancellation or 50% discount.
  2. Quantity allowance: up to 1000 m +/-7%, 1001-3000 m +/-5%, 3001-10000 m +/-3%. Extra fabric will not be taken or paid.
  3. Inspection standard: 20 points per 100 linear yards.
  4. Bulk testing is borne by the buyer; the cost of re-testing after a failure is borne by the supplier.
  5. Quality or quantity issues found after receipt will be raised with the supplier within 45 days.
  6. Shipping marks: colour, qty, roll no, lot no and consignee.

records.name: Standard Trim Terms
records.terms_text: Quantity allowance +/-5%. Quality as per the approved trim card.

records.name: AQL 2.5 General II (unconfirmed)
records.note: Values not yet confirmed against ISO 2859-1. QA must check before use.

records.name: Garment AQL 2.5 / 4.0 Level II
records.note: Lot ranges and sample sizes: ISO 2859-1 Table 2-A, Level II. Accept/Reject numbers are confirmed only for codes K, L and M (two sources agreed). QA must fill in and tick Confirmed on every other row from the standard before it is used.

records.name: Importer Security Filing (US)
records.note: Ocean cargo to the US: filed 24 hours before loading at the foreign port (19 CFR 149). Cut-off is used as the loading time. Verify before enabling.
